purpose: Public planning guides for international education research, applications, funding, immigration preparation, accommodation, and student safety.

documents.title: Study Abroad Guide
documents.description: An introduction to international education research, planning, applications, and preparation.

documents.title: Country Selection Guide
documents.description: Guidance for comparing destinations by education systems, costs, eligibility, safety, and career opportunities.

documents.title: University Selection Guide
documents.description: Guidance for evaluating universities, programmes, accreditation, recognition, and admission requirements.

documents.title: International Admission Guide
documents.description: Guidance on international admission eligibility, application requirements, selection, and enrolment.

documents.title: Study Abroad Application Process Guide
documents.description: A step-by-step overview of preparing, submitting, and tracking international university applications.

documents.title: Study Abroad Document Guide
documents.description: Guidance on academic records, identity documents, translations, attestations, and supporting application materials.

documents.title: Student Visa Guide
documents.description: General guidance on student visa requirements, applications, supporting evidence, and official immigration resources.

documents.title: Passport Application Guide
documents.description: General guidance on passport application procedures, required documents, renewals, and official application resources.

documents.title: English Language Test Guide
documents.description: Guidance on English language proficiency tests, preparation, scores, and institution-specific requirements.

documents.title: International Entrance Examination Guide
documents.description: An overview of relevant international entrance examinations, eligibility, preparation, and official test information.

documents.title: Tuition and Living Cost Guide
documents.description: Guidance on comparing tuition, accommodation, food, transport, insurance, and other living expenses.

documents.title: International Scholarship and Financial Aid Guide
documents.description: Guidance on researching international scholarships, eligibility, applications, deadlines, and funding conditions.

documents.title: International Education Loan Guide
documents.description: General guidance on education loan options, lender comparisons, repayment obligations, and borrowing considerations.

documents.title: International Student Accommodation Guide
documents.description: Guidance on student housing options, rental agreements, deposits, budgeting, and accommodation safety.

documents.title: International Student Health Insurance Guide
documents.description: Guidance on student insurance requirements, coverage, exclusions, and official destination-specific rules.

documents.title: International Student Part-Time Work Guide
documents.description: Guidance on applicable student work permissions, restrictions, and official employment rules.

documents.title: Post-Study Work Guide
documents.description: General guidance on post-study work pathways, eligibility, application procedures, and current official requirements.

documents.title: Study Abroad Pre-Departure Guide
documents.description: A preparation checklist covering travel documents, packing, accommodation, finances, and arrival arrangements.

documents.title: International Student Safety Guide
documents.description: Guidance on personal safety, emergency contacts, fraud prevention, digital security, and local support services.

contentStandards: Explain the intended audience and purpose of each guide.
Distinguish general planning advice from official requirements.
Verify immigration, employment, insurance, and entry rules using current official sources.
Explain relevant admission, documentation, funding, and accommodation procedures.
Include official source links and the last verification date.
Do not invent fees, deadlines, eligibility rules, or visa requirements.
Do not promise admission, scholarships, visa approval, employment, or immigration outcomes.
publishingChecklist: Review content for accuracy and relevance.
Confirm the destination country and applicable intake where relevant.
Verify current official government and institutional requirements.
Include working official source links and a verification date.
Review document readability, print layout, metadata, and accessibility.
Check hyperlinks, tables, page numbers, and document titles.
Remove personal identity, financial, immigration, and application records.
Confirm the deployed PDF exists before publishing a download link.

prohibitedContent: Visa applications and confidential immigration records
privacy.privateRecordsStorage: Store confidential applicant records only in secure backend storage with appropriate authentication and authorization.
